## Objective

Make full setup, preserved exceptions, recovery and safe assessment explicit.

## Scope

- Preflight and defaults
- Receipt/stage evolution
- Custom adoption
- Readiness and freshness

## Entry conditions

- Affected core owner interfaces are repaired.

## Exit criteria

- Three setup cases select the correct new or frozen operation.
- Required gaps prevent a full-success claim and diagnostics remain read-only.

## Risks

- Old receipt validators and pending transactions must keep their original semantics.

### Risks

- A full request is not blanket destructive or external authority.

### Acceptance criteria

- Purpose, source scope, identity, packages, roles, licensing, ownership, runtimes and pending transactions are inspected before conflicting changes.
- Inherited disabled defaults enter the full target; current explicit opt-outs are preserved with a visibly reduced outcome, and missing grants remain named blockers.

### Planned verification

- Run focused selection/identity/opt-out and pre-write refusal cases using existing initializer fixture conventions.
- Check that assessment and frozen historical resume do not select a new full operation implicitly.

### Risks

- No second setup ledger or fabricated cross-owner atomicity; record actual partial boundaries.

### Acceptance criteria

- A new operational extension references immutable base/module history and distinguishes asset completion from full request completion.
- Recognized interruption/retry states resume without replaying completed side effects; changed source/target inputs and locks stop recovery.

### Planned verification

- Run focused interruption before/after each new transaction boundary and an equivalent completed rerun.
- Compare historical base bytes/editions and exact source/target ownership before and after an upgrade fixture.

### Risks

- Keep historical static fields for their original purpose instead of silently redefining them.

### Acceptance criteria

- Installed/enabled/authorized/populated/functioning/fresh states and explicit exceptions are visible per feature; no required gap yields full success.
- Read-only assessment consumes attributable observations without provisioning, rebuilding, upgrading or executing unknown code; changed dependencies invalidate only affected evidence.

### Planned verification

- Run focused static-only-success/operational-failure, stale evidence, preserved gap and no-mutation cases.
- Verify old edition status remains interpretable and CLI outcomes agree with the new required capability set.
